Ukrainian skeleton racer Vladyslav Heraskevych has unveiled a new uniform for the national team, designed to draw attention to Ukraine’s occupied territories. The racing suit takes inspiration from the natural landscapes of southern Ukraine, particularly areas under Russian occupation. Its color palette evokes the region’s pink lakes, steppes, and coastline. The design also incorporates a pattern inspired by traditional Ukrainian vytynanky, or paper-cutting art. Heraskevych said the uniform is another way to highlight the occupied regions and Ukraine’s unique natural sites, which are facing an environmental catastrophe as a result of Russian aggression. 📸 : etnodim/Instagram
